context.transcript:
Hi, this is Jung Soo Kim.
I've finished my inspection of the house and it's in good shape, but I noticed something.
The rainwater's not draining properly.
When you move in, you'll need to have the rain gutters along the edge of the roof cleaned.
They're filled with dead leaves, which prevents the water from getting dirty.
They're filled with dead leaves, which prevents the water from flowing down the drain pipes and away from the house.
If it's not fixed, then over time, water build-up could possibly damage the house's foundation.
I'm going to send you and the sellers my complete inspection report along with pictures, but I won't include repair estimates because those vary so widely.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，我是 Jung Soo Kim。
我完成了对房子的检查，它状况良好，但我注意到了一些问题。
雨水没有正常排水。
您入住时需要清理屋顶边缘的落水管。
它们堆满了枯叶，这阻止了脏水进入。
它们堆满了枯叶，这阻止了水流进排水管道并远离房子。
如果这个问题不解决，随着时间的推移，积水可能会损害房子的地基。
我将把完整的检查报告和照片发送给您和卖家，但不会包括维修估价，因为这些差异太大了。
